questions.question: In which year did the first partition of Bengal bring that province to the brink of open rebellion?
In which year did the Government of India start a new category of languages called classical languages?
Which of the following is NOT a dimension of Human Development, as per the UNDP?
Which Article states the composition of the Parliament consisting of both the Houses and the President?
In which year did the Supreme Court issue a notice to the Government of India asking about its plan to teach Fundamental Duties to the citizens of the country?
Who traditionally delivers the speech on the eve of Republic Day in India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (President of India) है।

questions.question: What is the name of the first space-based Indian mission to study the Sun?
The preventive food safety system started in the 1960s is:
Which of the following climate types prevails in the Indian subcontinent?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Tropical Monsoon Climate) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a key component of rural development?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Agricultural and allied activities) है।

questions.question: Which of the following republican states was located in the Agra-Jaipur region during the Gupta period?
प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
Which of the following is NOT a Dhammalipi designated by Ashoka?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Rock Edict from Mysore) है।

questions.question: Which of the following food components is absorbed primarily in the ileum and requires intrinsic factor for its assimilation?
Writer Arundhati Roy won the Booker Prize in the year 1997 for her novel _____________.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (The God of Small Things) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Vedas contains 'magic spells' and 'charms' to ward off the evil spirits and diseases?
Which of the following states/UTs announced free bus travel for the transgender community in 2024?

मौलिक कर्तव्यों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

कथन:
1. भारत के मूल संविधान में मौलिक कर्तव्यों को शामिल नहीं किया गया था।
2. मौलिक कर्तव्यों को 1976 में 42वें संविधान संशोधन के माध्यम से जोड़ा गया था।
3. मौलिक कर्तव्य न्यायोचित हैं, अर्थात इन कर्तव्यों का उल्लंघन कानून द्वारा दंडनीय है।
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (केवल कथन 1 और 2) है।

questions.question: Chhath Puja, a ________ celebration, which takes place after Diwali, is dedicated to the Sun God and his wife Usha to thank them for sustaining life on earth and for granting wishes.
भारत के किस मंत्रालय द्वारा, 70वें राष्ट्रीय फिल्म पुरस्कारों की घोषणा की गई?
options: सूक्ष्म, लघु एवं मध्यम उद्यम मंत्रालय
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (सूचना एवं प्रसारण मंत्रालय) है।
